title: DreamGaussian: Generative Gaussian Splatting for Efficient 3D Content Creation
layout_note: Three dashed rounded panels: i) Generative Gaussian Splatting (top left) and ii) Efficient Mesh Extraction (top right) share the top row, iii) UV-Space Texture Refinement spans the full bottom row. Each panel runs left to right; panel iii ends in a long blue 'MSE Loss' arrow running back from the refined image to the random view.
grouping: Each stage is a dashed rounded frame in light orange with an italic gold title 'i)', 'ii)', 'iii)' in its top-left corner; no colour tints inside the frames.
shapes_depth: The diffusion prior is a flat grey bow-tie (hourglass) shape with its name inside; everything else is rendered imagery of the generated character (blurry Gaussians, half point-cloud / half rendered splits, a mesh half-wireframe, a UV texture atlas). A magnifier glyph marks the density query. Arrows are flat black for data and blue for optimisation.
proposed_highlight: Each stage is a titled dashed panel, and the optimisation signals are the only coloured text and arrows: blue 'Optimize', 'SDS Loss' and 'MSE Loss', separate from the black data arrows.
lesson: Lay out a three-stage pipeline as two short stages side by side above one long stage, each in a titled dashed rounded frame, and colour only the gradient arrows and loss labels blue so the optimisation reads apart from the data path.
notes: venue from the first page ('Published as a conference paper at ICLR 2024'). The 3D representation is 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) with SDS guidance as in DreamFusion; paradigm set to DreamFusion because the figure draws an SDS-guided generation pipeline.

arrangement.units: three dashed rounded light-orange frames, each titled in italic gold: stages i and ii share the top row, stage iii spans the bottom row
arrangement.inputs_as: the words 'Text/Image' above each diffusion-prior bow-tie with a down arrow; stage iii also starts from a UV texture map at its left
arrangement.losses_at: inside the stage they train: 'SDS Loss' in blue under the stage-i diffusion prior; 'MSE Loss' in blue on a long return arrow along the bottom of stage iii
arrangement.shared: the diffusion prior is drawn twice as the same grey bow-tie, once in stage i and once in stage iii; '3D Gaussians' are drawn again at the start of stage ii

taxonomy.task: image-to-3D and text-to-3D generation with Gaussian splatting and mesh export

insights.structure: Three dashed rounded frames: two short stages side by side on the top row and the long texture-refinement stage across the full bottom row, each with an italic numbered title in its corner.
insights.data: Intermediate results are renders of the actual generated character at each step (blurry Gaussians, densified Gaussians, a half-wireframe textured mesh, a UV atlas, refined views), and the diffusion model is an abstract grey bow-tie.
insights.emphasis: Blue is reserved for optimisation - the 'Optimize' arrows and the 'SDS Loss' and 'MSE Loss' labels - so the training signals stand apart from black data arrows.
insights.flow: Read stage i then ii across the top and then stage iii left to right below; inside stage iii the forward path goes right through the diffusion prior and a long blue arrow along the bottom returns the MSE loss to the random view.
insights.avoid: No arrow links the three stages to each other, so the hand-off from Gaussians to mesh to UV map must be inferred from repeated images and panel numbers.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)
